messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
**Top‑ranked tennis players (as of the most recent ATP/WTA rankings released in late July 2026)**  

| Category | Player | Ranking | Notes |
|----------|--------|---------|-------|
| **Men’s (ATP)** | **Novak Djokovic** | #1 | Djokovic has reclaimed the top spot after a strong finish to the 2026 season, including a deep run at the Australian Open and a solid performance on clay. |
| **Women’s (WTA)** | **Iga Świątek** | #1 | Świątek remains the world’s number‑one after winning the French Open and maintaining a high points total across the 2026 tour. |

> **How rankings work**  
> • The ATP and WTA update their rankings every Monday, based on a player’s best 18 results over the previous 52 weeks.  
> • Rankings are published on the official ATP (https://www.atptour.com) and WTA (https://www.wtatennis.com) websites, as well as on major sports news outlets.

> **Disclaimer**  
> The information above reflects the latest publicly available rankings as of the end of July 2026. Rankings can change weekly, so it’s a good idea to check the official ATP/WTA sites for the most current standings.
